title: Russo-Ukrainian war
summary: Armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine that, by the account of a Swedish research centre, began in the second half of February 2014 with Russia's occupation of Crimea, including the seizure of Crimea's parliament in Simferopol on 27 February 2014. Many commentators instead date it to Russia's full-scale attack of 24 February 2022.

uncertainty.note: Start date is debated; sources cited give second half of February 2014 (27 February for the Crimean parliament seizure). The war is described as ongoing; end year here only marks the start phase.

where.modern_name: Simferopol, Crimea, Ukraine (internationally recognised; occupied by Russia)
where.historical_name: Simferopol, Autonomous Republic of Crimea, Ukraine

importance.justification: Ongoing war between two states, with its start date and nature debated in scholarship and official accounts.

audience_note: Concerns an ongoing war with civilian and military casualties; this outline does not give casualty figures.

sources.title: Why the Russo-Ukrainian War Started Already in February 2014
sources.publisher: Stockholm Centre for Eastern European Studies (SCEEUS), Swedish Institute of International Affairs
sources.author: Julia Kazdobina, Jakob Hedenskog, Andreas Umland

sources.title: The history of Russia's aggression in Ukraine: Crimea invasion and Donbas

reviewer_note: Start date is contested in framing (Ukraine and SCEEUS say Feb 2014; many outside say 24 Feb 2022). Pin is Simferopol as a proxy for the Crimean start; the war spans all Ukraine.
